title: Update fail_closed docstring: catalog-recorded deletion detection is unconditional
description: Robustness review of bidu fix: class/property docstrings (dao_persistence.py:294-305 and __init__ arg doc) promise fail_closed=False returns None on missing state for testing scenarios, but the new catalog-backed branch raises regardless of the flag (intentional, spec 8.6 requires fail closed; inline comment acknowledges). Keep behavior, update the contract docs to state deletion detection for catalog-recorded keys is unconditional.
